item.title: JAPAN DATA: Jan naphtha-fed steam cracker runs fall to 75.8% from 77% in Dec
item.description: Japan’s naphtha-fed steam cracker operations in January averaged 75.8%, down from 77% in December 2025 and 80.6% in January 2025, the Japan Petrochemical Industry Association said Feb. 19. item.title: Vale set to re-enter shipping with a bang, plans to order 30 large ore carriers
item.description: Large newbuilding announcements are often interpreted as exogenous supply shocks, raising concerns about oversupply and pressure on freight rates. Vale’s plan to order 30 VLOCs has prompted similar reactions. item.description: The U.S. has unveiled a concrete blueprint to rebuild its shipbuilding industry by leveraging allied shipyards, including those in South Korea and Japan. item.description: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk index, which tracks rates for vessels transporting dry commodities, continued to fall for a third session on Thursday, dropping 2.1% to its lowest since February 11 at 2,019 points, amid ongoing subdued demand during the Lunar New Year in Asia.
